description: 兩岸經貿交流相關統計指標─中國大陸景氣指標:中國大陸工業及服務業用電量及成長率 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國家發展委員會. 提供中國大陸及兩岸經貿往來之相關指標供社會大眾參考. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國家發展委員會. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-11-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
